description: White-team hardening: contain the download endpoint to public/ (path traversal) and replace the hardcoded admin password with the ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable, while legitimate traffic keeps working. attack_check.py replays the attacks as the deterministic gate.

criteria: The download endpoint refuses names that escape public/ (../ segments and absolute paths) while readme.txt still resolves and reads; the hardcoded password literal is gone, ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment authenticates and wrong passwords are refused; the gate, the README, the public files and secret.txt are untouched.
